interpretations: host network: Core, the peer, the recording proxy and Engineering share the holder's loopback-only namespace and reach each other on 127.0.0.1; Docker refuses --add-host with a container network and the host's own network would give Core a route out

the upstream URL Engineering is given names the recording proxy (127.0.0.1:18087), which passes every exchange to the peer (127.0.0.1:18086) unchanged; the raw upstream response sha256 is of the bytes the peer sent
the control Core has component 2.2.1 and the two N32 wheels and no ha_mcp package: 2.2.1 names no ha-mcp pin, so none is copied and the run refuses if Core resolves one
the control's three requirements are answered by the committed S5 inventory-3 rows of 9.2.0, whose first three requirements are 2.2.1's; no new inventory ran
withheld: every *_withheld, *_dropped_by_policy and *_replaced counter Engineering's result carries, to depth 3, by key; values are counts only
the 8.5.0 catalog must lack the three disabled tools; whether it advertises ha_config_get_yaml is recorded, not required
whether Engineering admits each peer catalog under the D1 flags was not known before this run; each read's result class shows it
r12 reads the default Core blueprint homeassistant/motion_light.yaml in get mode

not_replayed.r27-apps: not replayable in the local lane (no Supervisor)

pass_means: both setups ran to their end, every posture check held, r12 succeeded in get mode, r27 was confirmed not replayable by its response, nothing stored carries a token and cleanup is proven; any other read Engineering answered with an error is a recorded result, not a failure
